title: XMH: Explainable Metaheuristics via Exact Operator-Level Shapley Value Attribution
description: Python framework for exact Shapley value attribution at the operator level in metaheuristic algorithms. Includes instrumented implementations of DE, GA, PSO, CMA-ES, SHADE, and JADE, and four attribution methods (Exact Shapley, QuickSHAP, canonical KernelSHAP, tracking).

creators.name: Parra Orellana, Francisco
